lines.text: Everyone sees the Lambo. And the watch on the wrist.
Five years later, only one of them is still worth the money.
A twenty twenty Lamborghini Urus: two hundred eleven grand new. Today? About one thirty-nine. Down thirty-four percent.
A steel Rolex Daytona: sixteen thousand nine hundred at retail. Resale? About thirty-two thousand.
A Patek Nautilus: thirty-five grand new. Now around a hundred twenty-four thousand.
The catch? Almost nobody gets one at retail. And the Rolex market is down eight percent in five years.
The car lost seventy-two grand. The watch made fifteen. Watch, or car?
